query: Which covariance parameterizations (diagonal, low-rank+diag, Kronecker-factored, per-channel) give the best memory/compute versus uncertainty-fidelity trade-off for 2D and 3D medical image resolutions?

response.query: Which covariance parameterizations (diagonal, low-rank+diag, Kronecker-factored, per-channel) give the best memory/compute versus uncertainty-fidelity trade-off for 2D and 3D medical image resolutions?
response.answer: For 2D and 3D medical images, Kronecker-factored and per-channel covariance parameterizations often provide the best memory/compute versus uncertainty-fidelity trade-off. These methods efficiently manage complexity while maintaining high uncertainty estimation accuracy.
